records.literal_gloss: ? Will make for himself a human gods? And they [are] not gods.

en.L: Will a human make gods for himself? \q And they [are] not gods!
en.B: Can people make gods for themselves? \q Such things are not gods at all!
en.R: Can people make their own gods? \q No! The things they make are not gods at all.

es.L: ¿Hará el hombre dioses para sí? \q ¡Y no son dioses!
es.B: ¿Puede la gente fabricarse dioses? \q ¡Esas cosas no son dioses en absoluto!
es.R: ¿Pueden las personas hacerse sus propios dioses? \q ¡No! Lo que hacen no son dioses en absoluto.

fr.L: Un être humain se fera-t-il des dieux ? \q Mais ce ne [sont] pas des dieux !
fr.B: Les gens peuvent-ils se fabriquer des dieux ? \q Ce ne sont pas du tout des dieux !
fr.R: Les gens peuvent-ils fabriquer leurs propres dieux ? \q Non ! Ce qu’ils fabriquent, ce ne sont pas du tout des dieux.

sw.L: Je, mwanadamu atajifanyia miungu? \q Nayo si miungu!
sw.B: Je, watu wanaweza kujitengenezea miungu? \q Vitu hivyo si miungu hata kidogo!
sw.R: Je, watu wanaweza kujitengenezea miungu yao wenyewe? \q Hapana! Vitu wanavyovitengeneza si miungu hata kidogo.

vi.L: Con người có thể làm thần cho mình sao? \q Mà chúng chẳng phải [là] thần!
vi.B: Con người có thể tự làm ra thần cho mình sao? \q Những thứ ấy chẳng phải là thần chút nào!
vi.R: Con người có thể tự làm ra thần của mình sao? \q Không! Những thứ họ làm ra chẳng phải là thần gì cả.

ko.L: 사람이 자기를 위해 신들을 만들겠습니까? \q 그것들은 신이 아닙니다!
ko.B: 사람이 자기를 위해 신들을 만들 수 있겠습니까? \q 그런 것들은 결코 신이 아닙니다!
ko.R: 사람이 자기 신을 만들 수 있겠습니까? \q 아닙니다! 사람이 만든 것은 결코 신이 아닙니다.

pt.L: Fará um ser humano deuses para si? \q E eles não [são] deuses!
pt.B: Podem as pessoas fazer deuses para si mesmas? \q Essas coisas não são deuses de modo nenhum!
pt.R: Será que as pessoas podem fazer os seus próprios deuses? \q Não! As coisas que elas fazem não são deuses de jeito nenhum.

am.L: ሰው ለራሱ አማልክትን ይሠራልን? \q እነርሱም አማልክት አይደሉም!
am.B: ሰዎች ለራሳቸው አማልክትን መሥራት ይችላሉን? \q እንዲህ ያሉት ነገሮች ፈጽሞ አማልክት አይደሉም!
am.R: ሰዎች የራሳቸውን አማልክት መሥራት ይችላሉን? \q አይችሉም! የሚሠሯቸው ነገሮች ፈጽሞ አማልክት አይደሉም።

hi.L: क्या मनुष्य अपने लिए देवता बना सकता है? \q और वे तो देवता [हैं] ही नहीं!
hi.B: क्या मनुष्य अपने लिए देवता बना सकते हैं? \q ऐसी वस्तुएँ तो देवता हैं ही नहीं!
hi.R: क्या लोग अपने लिए देवता बना सकते हैं? \q नहीं! जो चीज़ें वे बनाते हैं, वे देवता हैं ही नहीं।

ru.L: Разве сделает себе человек богов? \q Но они — не боги!
ru.B: Разве могут люди сделать себе богов? \q Такие вещи — вовсе не боги!
ru.R: Могут ли люди сами сделать себе богов? \q Нет! То, что они делают, — вовсе не боги.

ja.L: 人が自分のために神々を造るだろうか？ \q それらは神々ではない！
ja.B: 人が自分のために神々を造れるだろうか？ \q そのようなものは、決して神ではない！
ja.R: 人が自分で神々を造れるだろうか？ \q いや、人が造るものは、決して神ではない。

uk.L: Чи зробить собі людина богів? \q А вони не боги!
uk.B: Хіба можуть люди зробити собі богів? \q Таке зовсім не боги!
uk.R: Хіба люди можуть зробити собі богів? \q Ні! Те, що вони роблять, — зовсім не боги.

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: Something a human makes cannot be a god (2:11; 5:7; 10:3-5; Isaiah 44:9-20). The verse may still be the nations speaking, or Jeremiah's own comment on their words; it means the same either way.

decisions.choice: a human: any person, a mortal
decisions.reason: The word is the general word for a human being, set against God.

decisions.choice: people ... themselves
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "people" for the single "human", since the question is about anyone.

decisions.choice: 'adam "人" (every level, m2, no gender span needed); 'elohim "神々" / "神"; the question expects "no" (m1), made explicit at R ("いや").
decisions.reason: As the English levels.

source.text: לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י מֽוֹדִיעָ֔ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֔את אוֹדִיעֵ֥ם אֶת־יָדִ֖י וְאֶת־גְּבֽוּרָתִ֑י וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־שְׁמִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, here I [am] making them know at the time this; I will make them know my hand and my might, and they will know that my name [is] Yahweh.

en.L: Therefore, look, I am going to make them know; \q this time I will make them know {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} might, \q and they will know that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Therefore I am going to teach them; \q this time I will make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} might known to them, \q and they will know that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So I will teach them. \q This time I will show them {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} strength. \q Then they will know that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Por tanto, he aquí que les haré conocer; \q esta vez les haré conocer {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder, \q y sabrán que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por eso voy a enseñarles; \q esta vez les daré a conocer {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} fuerza, \q y sabrán que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso les enseñaré. \q Esta vez les mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} fuerza. \q Entonces sabrán que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi voici, je vais leur faire connaître ; \q cette fois, je leur ferai connaître {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance, \q et ils sauront que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je vais les instruire ; \q cette fois, je leur ferai connaître {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} force et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance, \q et ils sauront que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors je vais les instruire. \q Cette fois, je leur montrerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} force et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance. \q Alors ils sauront que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, tazama, nitawajulisha; \q wakati huu nitawajulisha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na uweza {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q nao watajua ya kuwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo karibu nitawafundisha; \q wakati huu nitawajulisha nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na uweza {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q nao watajua ya kuwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitawafundisha. \q Wakati huu nitawaonyesha nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na uweza {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Ndipo watajua kwamba jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì vậy, kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho chúng biết; \q lần này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho chúng biết tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và chúng sẽ biết rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dạy cho chúng biết; \q lần này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho chúng biết quyền lực và sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và chúng sẽ biết rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dạy cho chúng. \q Lần này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho chúng thấy quyền năng và sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Bấy giờ chúng sẽ biết rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 보아라, 내가 그들에게 알게 하겠다. \q 이번에는 내 손과 내 능력을 그들에게 알게 하겠다. \q 그러면 그들이 내 이름이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 그들을 깨우쳐 주겠다. \q 이번에는 내 권능과 내 힘을 그들에게 알려 주겠다. \q 그러면 그들이 내 이름이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 내가 그들을 가르치겠다. \q 이번에는 내 능력과 힘을 그들에게 보여 주겠다. \q 그러면 그들은 내 이름이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}라는 것을 알게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Por isso, eis que vou fazê-los conhecer; \q desta vez lhes farei conhecer a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder, \q e saberão que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Por isso vou ensiná-los; \q desta vez vou lhes dar a conhecer a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} força e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder, \q e saberão que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Por isso vou ensiná-los. \q Desta vez vou lhes mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} força e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder. \q Então eles vão saber que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: ስለዚህ እነሆ፣ አስታውቃቸዋለሁ፤ \q በዚህች ጊዜ እጄንና ኃይሌን አስታውቃቸዋለሁ፤ \q ስሜም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆነ ያውቃሉ።
am.B: ስለዚህ አስተምራቸዋለሁ፤ \q በዚህ ጊዜ ኃይሌንና ብርታቴን አሳውቃቸዋለሁ፤ \q ስሜም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆነ ያውቃሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ አስተምራቸዋለሁ። \q በዚህ ጊዜ ኃይሌንና ብርታቴን አሳያቸዋለሁ። \q ያን ጊዜ ስሜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆነ ያውቃሉ።

hi.L: इसलिए देखो, मैं उन्हें जनाऊँगा; \q इस बार मैं उन्हें अपना हाथ और अपना पराक्रम जनाऊँगा, \q और वे जानेंगे कि मेरा नाम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है।
hi.B: इसलिए मैं उन्हें सिखाने पर हूँ; \q इस बार मैं उन पर अपना सामर्थ्य और अपना पराक्रम प्रकट करूँगा, \q और वे जानेंगे कि मेरा नाम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है।
hi.R: इसलिए मैं उन्हें सिखाऊँगा। \q इस बार मैं उन्हें अपनी शक्ति और अपना बल दिखाऊँगा। \q तब वे जान लेंगे कि मेरा नाम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है।

ru.L: Поэтому вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам им узнать; \q на этот раз {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам им узнать {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку и {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} мощь, \q и они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} научу их; \q на этот раз {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам им узнать {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} силу и {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} могущество, \q и они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} научу их. \q На этот раз {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу им {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} силу и {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} могущество. \q Тогда они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: それゆえ、見なさい、わたしは彼らに知らせる。 \q 今度こそ、わたしの手とわたしの力を彼らに知らせる。 \q 彼らは、わたしの名が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.B: それゆえ、わたしは彼らに教える。 \q 今度こそ、わたしの力と勢いを彼らに知らせる。 \q 彼らは、わたしの名が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.R: だから、わたしは彼らに教える。 \q 今度こそ、わたしの力と強さを彼らに示す。 \q そのとき彼らは、わたしの名が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。

uk.L: Тому ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам їм пізнати; \q цього разу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам їм пізнати {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку і {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} могутність, \q і вони пізнають, що {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Тому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навчу їх; \q цього разу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу їм {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} силу і {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} могутність, \q і вони пізнають, що {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тож {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навчу їх. \q Цього разу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покажу їм {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} силу і {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} могутність. \q Тоді вони пізнають, що {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: God answers; "them" may be the nations or Judah
decisions.reason: God speaks again in the first person. "Them" may be the nations who make idols (verses 19-20), or the people of Judah, who will learn through judgment who God is (verses 10-18).

decisions.choice: my hand and my might: my power in action
decisions.reason: The hand stands for strength put to work, as in the exodus (Exodus 13:9; Deuteronomy 26:8).

decisions.choice: they will know that my name is Yahweh: they will know God as he truly is
decisions.reason: The name stands for who God is. The words echo the exodus, when God acted so that Israel and Egypt would know that he is the LORD (Exodus 6:3, 7; 7:5; compare Isaiah 42:8).

decisions.choice: teach them; power for "hand"
decisions.reason: The verb means "make them know"; Balanced and Readable say "teach" for the first and keep "make ... known" (B) or "show" (R) for the second. "Hand" means power.

decisions.choice: "danh Ta là CHÚA", the name under the divine_name setting
decisions.reason: The verse turns on the name itself; with the setting the reader may see "Gia-vê" here, as the English shows "Yahweh".

decisions.choice: 내 이름이 주인 줄 알게 될 것이다
alternatives: | The recognition formula follows the terms note (내가 주인 줄 알게 될 것이다, 1 Kings 20:13), here with "my name" as the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: मेरा नाम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है
decisions.reason: With the setting on its default the line reads "my name is प्रभु", as the English reads "my name is the LORD"; the alternative याहवे shows that the name itself is meant.

decisions.choice: силу for "hand"
decisions.reason: "Hand" means power in action (the meaning decision), so Balanced and Readable say "сила"; Literal keeps "рука".

decisions.choice: God answers (m1) in plain style; yadi "わたしの手" (L), "わたしの力" (B, R) (m2); shemi YHWH "わたしの名が{D}である", the span reading 主 or ヤハウェ.
decisions.reason: As the English levels.
